svg.title: Bricklayer — Woman
svg.desc: A fictional woman working as bricklayer, wearing an apron and a hard hat. Visible work cue: A pointed masonry trowel with an angled raised handle is paired with two staggered brick courses. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: a hard hat.
